title: 第175章 巧了第174章 出发南国
content_zh:
睁开眼的百里识越差点一口气没提上来。
虞繁花抖开裙子上的蜘蛛，掏出长枪，枪头点火，扫开前方大片蜘蛛，“安先知，你带的好路。”
“我还真没料到。”安衍毫不心虚，思索着看向沈二，她脖颈处空空如也，“兔子呢？”
沈二下意识摸了摸脖子，“不知道，估计又跑哪玩去了。”
“也不算带错路，南矞两国以迷踪林为界，不从迷踪林过得多耗费几个月的路程。”韩执旭说。
这个走法，百里识越是个很好的先例，现在这个情形只能说运气不好。
“快想想办法！”
四周诡异的蜘蛛爬动声让人头皮发麻，百里识越不知是该捂眼睛还是捂耳朵，手忙脚乱到后面什么都没捂上。
“在想了。”沈二也是无法，把息玄发出来，没成想它还真吃这玩意，一口一个嘎嘣脆。
但是单靠吃是吃不完的。
“你们拿着这个。”韩执旭给他们一人递了一个火把，“蜘蛛怕火，拿着火把它们不敢靠近。”
“你们快看那边！”虞繁花喊道。
百里识越猛地摇头，“不看不看不看，打死我我也不会再睁眼了。”
不睁眼是对的，沈二心想，看向虞繁花所指，眉头紧皱，“那是蜘蛛王吗？”
只见涌动的蜘蛛潮之上，爬着一只体型大出上百倍的蛛王，脑袋上那两排眼睛呈猩红色，身上涌动的灵气显示，它至少有四阶。
“不要轻举妄动，”安衍压低声音，“它没注意到我们。”
沈二这才注意到，那只蛛王的头确实没有朝向他们这边。它正爬过一片光秃秃的岩石，八条长腿交替移动，动作不紧不慢，像是在巡视领地。
它身下的蜘蛛潮虽然密集，但大部分都紧跟着它，没有朝他们这边涌过来。
像是路过。
安衍说：“毛蛛大部分都是友好的，它们这样应该是集体搬迁，又或许是什么东西捣毁了它们的老巢，让它们不得不搬家。”

他的话引人深思。
虞繁花问：“那是什么让它们搬家？”
“要么是有更强大的妖物侵占它们的领地，要么……”安衍顿了顿，“是人为。”
此话一出，众人心里都有了答案。
迷踪林生活着无数妖兽，人族为获取资源，常常到迷踪林历练，这种事情已是见怪不怪，没有把它们全部打死都算好的。
“我们管不了，多一事不如少一事，顾好自己就行。”
安衍这话主要是说给沈二听的。
沈二冲他笑了笑，“知道，人不犯我，我不犯人，我们继续赶路吧。”
嘴上答应得好好的，心里却在想，要是半道遇到那些王八蛋，她可不敢保证不动手。
安衍看穿她的心思，一把抓住她的手腕，“此地凶险，最好不要乱来。”
“我又不傻，我的意思是如果半道遇上，别人要是主动找麻烦，我总得反击吧？”
“……你先答应我。”
“我答应你。”
content_en:
Baili Shiyue, who opened his eyes, almost couldn't even lift it up.
Yu Fanhua shook off the spiders on her skirt, took out her spear, lit the gun tip, and swept away the large spiders in front of her, "Sir An, you led the way well."
"I really didn't expect that." An Yan didn't feel guilty and looked at Shen Er thoughtfully. There was nothing on her neck, "Where's the rabbit?"
Shen Er subconsciously touched his neck, "I don't know, I guess he went somewhere to play again."
"It's not like we took the wrong route. The two countries in Nanjing are bounded by the Mizong Forest. If we don't go through the Mizong Forest, it would take several more months to travel." Han Zhixu said.
Baili Shiyue is a good precedent for this move. The current situation can only be said to be bad luck.
"Think of a solution quickly!"
The strange crawling sound of spiders all around made people's scalp numb. Baili Shiyue didn't know whether to cover his eyes or ears. He was so busy that he didn't cover anything behind him.
"I'm thinking about it." Shen Er was also helpless and sent out the Xi Xuan, but he didn't expect it to actually eat this thing, crunching and crunching every bite.
But you can’t finish it all by eating alone.
"Take this." Han Zhixu handed each of them a torch. "Spiders are afraid of fire. They don't dare to approach with a torch."
"Look over there!" Yu Fanhua shouted.
Baili Shiyue shook his head violently, "If you don't look at it, I won't open my eyes again if you kill me."
It's right not to open your eyes, Shen Er thought to himself. He looked at what Yu Fanhua was pointing at and frowned, "Is that the Spider King?"
On top of the surging spider tide, crawling was a spider king that was hundreds of times larger. The two rows of eyes on its head were scarlet, and the spiritual energy surging on its body showed that it was at least the fourth level.
"Don't act rashly," An Yan lowered his voice, "It didn't notice us."
Only then did Shen Er notice that the spider king's head was indeed not facing towards them. It was crawling across a bare rock, its eight long legs moving alternately, unhurriedly, as if it was patrolling its territory.
Although the tide of spiders under it was dense, most of them followed it closely and did not rush towards them.
Like passing by.
An Yan said: "Most of the hairy spiders are friendly. They should have moved collectively, or maybe something destroyed their old nest and forced them to move."
His words are thought-provoking.
Yu Fanhua asked: "What made them move?"
"Either there are more powerful monsters invading their territory, or..." Anyan paused, "It's man-made."
As soon as these words came out, everyone had the answer in their hearts.
There are countless monsters living in the Lost Forest. In order to obtain resources, humans often go to the Lost Forest for training. This kind of thing is not surprising, so it is better not to kill them all.
"We can't control it. One more thing is worse than one less thing. Just take care of yourself."
An Yan's words were mainly meant for Shen Er.
Shen Er smiled at him, "I know, I won't offend anyone unless they offend me, so let's continue on our way."
She promised well on her lips, but she was thinking in her heart that if she met those bastards on the way, she couldn't promise not to do anything.
An Yan saw through her thoughts and grabbed her wrist, "This place is dangerous, it's best not to mess around."
"I'm not stupid. What I mean is that if we meet halfway and someone else takes the initiative to cause trouble, I have to fight back, right?"
"...Promise me first."
"I promise you."
